scope: Course signup setup, including server code, safe defaults, deployment steps, and verification.
reason: The user explicitly cannot understand or review server code and will copy-paste the deliverable, directly triggering the default full mode.
handoff: Do this: use a hosted signup form connected to a private course roster. Careful: keep student details private and collect only what you need. Check it worked: submit a test signup and confirm it appears once in the roster. Decided for you: chose a hosted form over custom server code because it reduces maintenance. Only you can decide: whether signup requires payment; assumed free.
